Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, and Building Standards
September 23, 2026
City Council Meeting

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-3,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-H and
3-H in the area bound by:

North Wood Street; the alley next north of and parallel to West Chicago Avenue;
North Ashland Avenue; and the alley next south of and parallel to West Chicago
Avenue,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-2,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-H and
3-H in the area bound by:

North Wood Street; the alley next north of and parallel to West Chicago Avenue;
North Ashland Avenue; and the alley next south of and parallel to West Chicago
Avenue,

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 3. All existing B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed Use District, B3-2 Neighborhood
Shopping District, B3-1 Neighborhood Shopping District, and B1-5 Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols shall be excluded from this ordinance (a.k.a., 1604 — 1608 W
Chicago; 1612 W Chicago; 1611 — 1635 W Chicago; 1641 W Chicago; 1705 W
Chicago; 1709 W Chicago; 1721 W Chicago; and 1749 W Chicago). Please see the
Appendix for further explanation of the properties subject to this ordinance.

SECTION 4. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Lud LL Loh

“Daniel La Spata ~
Alderman, 1%* Ward

Common Address:
1600-1760 W. Chicago
1601-1759 W. Chicago
